sections.title: The local cloud, packaged
lines: The local cloud packaged (seer/) — seer/bindSeer.sh asks (a Tiiny or not, sleep sounds + ACE-Step, local models, THE COMMONS, ComfyUI, an OpenRouter key), writes seer/.seer, and make.py writes LiteLLM's config, n8n's env and the workflows from it so they agree: four names (seer-talk, -quick, -hear, -voice) whatever answers them; n8n in our docker compose; launchd or systemd; —adopt for a machine set up by hand. The Tiiny's voice, sleep sounds, Whisper and the companion's n8n workflows move here from DAEMONS ai/

setup.title: THE LOCAL CLOUD
setup.where: a second always-on computer beside the hub (seer/ in this repository)
needs: a Mac or a Linux box that stays on, beside the hub
a Tiiny, if you have one (optional)
about 19 GB free, for sleep sounds
steps: On that computer, clone the companion (github.com/CodeMusic/daemons-companion) and run seer/bindSeer.sh. seer/README.md tells the whole of it.
Answer its questions: a Tiiny or not (its address and key, from tiiny auth key), sleep sounds, local models, THE COMMONS, ComfyUI, and an OpenRouter key if you want one.
When it finishes it prints what to give the hub (seer/out/hub.txt): its address and key go in SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK › THE TIINY.
Run it again any time: it offers your last answers. seer/bindSeer.sh --plan says what it would do and installs nothing.

setup.title: SLEEP SOUNDS
needs: the hub
the local cloud's music maker (seer/bindSeer.sh, port 4002)
headphones, for DRIFT DOWN
steps: The pieces are made by ACE-Step on the local cloud, the always-on machine beside the hub that runs LiteLLM. On that machine, from a clone of daemons-companion, run seer/bindSeer.sh and say yes to sleep sounds (the first time, it downloads about 19 GB). It answers on port 4002 and turns away anyone without a key.

The hub finds it beside THE TIINY: SETTINGS › WHO ANSWERS WHEN YOU TALK › THE TIINY, its address on port 4000 and its key. The hub knocks on port 4002 of the same machine with the same key (the hub's sleep.url setting names another door).
Open DAEMON › DREAMS. SLEEP SOUNDS asks for tonight's piece, made from your daemon's day; the first takes a few minutes, and then it is kept on the phone.
It plays for thirty minutes and fades over the last ten.
DRIFT DOWN needs headphones: put them on first. On a speaker it waits, and the music plays alone.
